identity_check: Confirmed as Flow Engineering (flowengineering.com, branded 'Flow'), a requirements-management and agentic systems-engineering platform for hardware teams, founded and led by CEO Pari Singh. The seed release is datelined London, 6 December 2022. The Series A post says Flow relocated its HQ to San Francisco, and the Series B release is datelined San Francisco, 2026-09-30; Unite.AI calls it 'a San Francisco company'. Not the unrelated UK Companies House registrants with similar names (e.g. FLOW ENGINEERING LIMITED, Newport, no. 07491866, incorporated 2011), and not generic flow / fluid-engineering consultancies. Category direct and layer design_intent kept from our notes: Flow's own pages describe requirements management, traceability and verification across CAD, simulation, code and test, which is the requirements / design-intent tooling Utopian Autonomy builds for hardware teams. Our notes are confirmed: $50M Series B at a $750M valuation co-led by Valor (Antonio Gracias) and Atreides (Gavin Baker), and published pricing of USD 150 (Basic) and USD 300 (Pro) per editor per month.

company.name: Flow Engineering
company.description: Requirements and systems-engineering platform for hardware teams, with AI agents that keep CAD, simulation, code and test aligned.

layer_detail: Requirements management, traceability and verification & validation for hardware programs; agents run change-impact analysis and check requirement and test coverage across requirements, CAD, simulation, code and test. Began as a requirements tool; MBSE and test cases/plans included; ITAR AWS GovCloud on Enterprise.
named_customers: Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies (RV Tech)
product_summary: Cloud requirements and systems-engineering tool that acts as the continuously updated record for hardware development, linking requirements, CAD, simulation, code and test. AI agents analyse engineering changes, trace downstream impact and check requirement and test coverage inside engineers' existing tools; ITAR GovCloud option for regulated programs.
pricing: Published on flowengineering.com/pricing (read 2026-10-30): Basic USD 150 per editor per month (500 requirements, 1 project, all integrations, API); Pro USD 300 per editor per month (5,000 requirements, 5 projects, priority support); Enterprise custom (ITAR AWS GovCloud, custom integrations, SSO/SAML). Viewer licences available.
